subject: Signal and System
questionText:
A periodic signal which can be expanded in Fourier 
series  
 
(a) is a power signal  
 
(b) is an energy signal 
 
(c) is neither a power signal or an energy signal 
 
(d) can be either a power signal or an energy signal 
depending on the nature.

options.text: is neither a power signal or an energy signal
can be either a power signal or an energy signal

explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-17 (Properties of CTFS).
